title.zh: Amazon is taking its biggest shot at Nvidia yet with new TorchNeuron dev tool
title.en: Amazon is taking its biggest shot at Nvidia yet with new TorchNeuron dev tool

current_state.zh: Amazon introduced TorchNeuron, a developer tool designed to reduce Nvidia's grip on PyTorch by making it easier to run AI workloads on alternative chips such as its own.
